entries.name: Anymail
entries.use_for: Django email integration for Amazon SES, Postmark, Resend, SendGrid and more
entries.why: One Django API across 20+ email providers incl. tracking webhooks and inbound

entries.name: BillionMail
entries.use_for: Self-hosted mail server plus newsletter and email-marketing platform
entries.why: All-in-one open source mail server with campaigns and analytics; AGPL-3.0.

entries.name: docker-mailserver
entries.use_for: Production-ready full mail server (Postfix, Dovecot, Rspamd) in one container
entries.why: The simplest way to self-host a full mail stack with config files only

entries.name: Email Templates
entries.use_for: Create, preview and send custom email templates for Node.js
entries.why: Popular Nodemailer companion for templated emails with preview and i18n

entries.name: Haraka
entries.use_for: Run a programmable, high-performance SMTP server with Node.js plugins.
entries.why: Event-driven SMTP server used at scale for inbound filtering and outbound delivery; extend it in JS.

entries.name: Lettre
entries.use_for: Build and send email from Rust applications.
entries.why: The standard Rust mailer crate with async SMTP, TLS and message building.

entries.name: listmonk
entries.use_for: Self-host newsletters and mailing lists with an API and admin dashboard.
entries.why: Single Go binary with Postgres; very fast at large lists and exposes a full API for app integration.

entries.name: mailcow
entries.use_for: Dockerised mail server suite with web UI, groupware and spam filtering
entries.why: Popular self-hosted mail suite with admin UI, SOGo webmail and ActiveSync

entries.name: MailKit
entries.use_for: Send and read email (SMTP, IMAP, POP3) from .NET.
entries.why: Microsoft-recommended replacement for System.Net.Mail; robust, standards-compliant and cross-platform.

entries.name: Mailpit
entries.use_for: Catch outgoing email locally during development and inspect it in a web UI.
entries.why: Modern successor to MailHog: single binary, fast UI, API for automated tests and HTML compatibility checks.

entries.name: Maizzle
entries.use_for: Build HTML emails with Tailwind CSS and inline-CSS post-processing
entries.why: Tailwind-first email framework that produces production-ready, inlined HTML

entries.name: Mautic
entries.use_for: Open-source marketing automation: email campaigns, segments and landing pages
entries.why: The main open-source alternative to HubSpot/Mailchimp automation

entries.name: MJML
entries.use_for: Write responsive email layouts in simple markup that compiles to client-safe HTML.
entries.why: Long-standing standard for responsive email markup; handles Outlook/Gmail quirks so you do not hand-write tables.

entries.name: Nodemailer
entries.use_for: Send email from Node.js via SMTP or provider transports.
entries.why: The default email-sending module for Node, with attachments, DKIM, OAuth2 and pluggable transports.

entries.name: Novu
entries.use_for: Orchestrate email, SMS, push and in-app notifications through one API and workflow engine.
entries.why: Open-source notification infrastructure with provider integrations, digests, preferences and an inbox component.

entries.name: PHPMailer
entries.use_for: Send email from PHP applications over SMTP.
entries.why: The classic, most-used PHP mail library with SMTP auth, TLS, attachments and HTML mail.

entries.name: Postal
entries.use_for: Self-host a SendGrid/Mailgun-style platform for sending and receiving app email.
entries.why: Full mail delivery platform with HTTP API, webhooks, click/open tracking and multiple organizations.

entries.name: React Email
entries.use_for: Build HTML email templates as React components and render them for any provider.
entries.why: Modern component set that outputs client-compatible HTML, with a local preview server; works with any sender.

entries.name: React Email Editor
entries.use_for: Embed a drag-and-drop email template builder in a React app.
entries.why: Wraps the Unlayer editor so end users can design emails visually; exports HTML and JSON designs.

entries.name: Resend Node.js
entries.use_for: Official Node.js SDK for the Resend email API
entries.why: Official SDK for Resend; pairs directly with React Email templates

entries.name: Stalwart
entries.use_for: All-in-one mail server (SMTP, IMAP, JMAP, POP3) with spam filtering, in Rust
entries.why: Modern single-binary mail server with JMAP and built-in spam filter; AGPL-3.0 or commercial

license_verified.note: Dual-licensed AGPL-3.0-only or proprietary Stalwart Enterprise License v2 (REUSE headers, LICENSES/ folder)
